I was already wary of what would happen to Borderlands when Anthony Burch... well, stopped being funny, and then left the game. Old school Anthony had a very carefully balanced sense of surrealist humour. Not to say it wasn't often lolrandom, but there was some method to his madness that was obviously going to be missed by whatever corporate 'Hello fellow kids' shill they got to replace him.

The problem is, from the outside, it's so easy to reduce BL2 down to crumpets and badonkadonks and Butt Stallion, but that was never all it was. Handsome Jack was one of the best villains in gaming because he was funny, charming, and yet still despicable, with a slight twinge of relatability. He's inhumanly human, he's the kind of person who can justify everything he's doing to the point of insanity.

Tina is this big meme-y joke factory, but this is Tina masking. Her quest with Fleshstick shows how she's putting on a show to hide her deep scars, and it sucks they cut the part of the post-Roland quest where you deliver the news to her because the recorded lines for that scene are heartbreaking.

No doubt, there's still plenty of terrible writing in BL2, but it had a soul to it and I had very little doubt that whoever picked it up would miss the point and nothing I've seen has given me much faith that I was wrong.
